# Documentation

- [Architecture](/docs/architecture): Understand how the KloudMate Agent manages the OpenTelemetry Collector lifecycle.
- [Configuration](/docs/configuration): Configure the KloudMate Agent locally or via remote management.
- [KloudMate Agents](/docs): An OpenTelemetry Collector distribution with automated deployment, remote configuration, eBPF-powered zero-code observability, and auto-instrumentation support.
- [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting): Common issues and how to resolve them when using the KloudMate Agent.
- [Upgrade Your KloudMate Agent](/docs/upgrade-to-v2): Move from Agent 1.x to 2.x for eBPF tracing, service discovery, managed configuration, and Docker awareness.
- [Overview](/docs/apm): Application Performance Monitoring capabilities within KloudMate Agent.
- [Manual Instrumentation](/docs/apm/manual-instrumentation): Use OpenTelemetry SDKs directly in your application code for rich, customized tracing and metrics.
- [Zero Code Instrumentation](/docs/apm/zero-code-instrumentation): Auto-instrument your applications without code changes using OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation agents.
- [Zero-Downtime O11y (eBPF)](/docs/apm/zero-downtime-observability): Instrument Linux services with the KloudMate eBPF agent: no code changes, no application restarts.
- [Connectors](/docs/components/connectors): OpenTelemetry Collector connectors bundled with the KloudMate Agent.
- [Exporters](/docs/components/exporters): OpenTelemetry Collector exporters bundled with the KloudMate Agent.
- [Extensions](/docs/components/extensions): OpenTelemetry Collector extensions bundled with the KloudMate Agent.
- [Components Overview](/docs/components): OpenTelemetry Collector components bundled with the KloudMate Agent.
- [Processors](/docs/components/processors): OpenTelemetry Collector processors bundled with the KloudMate Agent.
- [Receivers](/docs/components/receivers): OpenTelemetry Collector receivers bundled with the KloudMate Agent.
- [AWS ASG Deployment](/docs/installation/aws-asg): Deploy kmagent across an Auto Scaling Group with zero manual per-instance work.
- [Infrastructure as a Code (IaaC) Installation](/docs/installation/iaac): Deploy the KloudMate agent across any cloud provider or on-premises infrastructure using Infrastructure as a Code (IaaC) and automation tools.
- [Installation](/docs/installation): Install the KloudMate Agent on Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, or Windows.
- [Database Access Monitoring (DAM)](/docs/databases/ebpf): eBPF-powered database monitoring without any hassle.
- [Databases Monitoring](/docs/databases): Monitor database queries and performance seamlessly.
- [OpenTelemetry Database Monitoring](/docs/databases/otel): Monitor databases using OpenTelemetry SDK instrumentation for rich query tracing.
- [Direct Database Monitoring](/docs/databases/sql-setup): Set up SQL-based monitoring with a dedicated monitoring user, helper procedures, and deep query analytics.
